Trump Admin Funds Shifted from Human Rights to Far-Right Causes

The Trump administration has been shifting funds away from human rights initiatives to support far-right causes. Additionally, the administration is paying $1.6 million weekly to keep Voice of America staff on leave. The administration is also reportedly using significant civil fines to encourage self-deportation.
